info.description:
Deterministic Western + Vedic astrology API for AI agents: JPL DE440 ephemeris, no LLM, reproducible SHA-256 hashes.

Pay per call with **x402** (USDC on Base or Solana) or **MPP** (Tempo: OUSD or USDC.e). No account, no API key. First 3 calls free per client on the five $0.01-0.02 routes (any tool over MCP); every other route is always paid.

- Positions from NASA/JPL DE440 (NASA/JPL), 1800-01-01..2200-01-01, via Skyfield: geocentric apparent, true equinox of date, IAU 2006/2000A.
- Historical time zones resolved for you (IANA tz database, DST of the era, Local Mean Time); ambiguous or non-existent local times are flagged, never guessed.
- Deterministic, no LLM: same input -> same bytes. Every response carries meta.input_sha256 and meta.result_sha256 (also as X-Input-SHA256 / X-Result-SHA256 headers); POST /v1/verify recomputes one.
- Every convention is in the response: ayanamsa (name, true and mean value), house system, orbs, node type, dasha year length, dosha and koota rule sets.
- Cross-validated against an independent engine (XALEN, Apache-2.0): ayanamsas agree to < 0.1", 15/16 divisional charts identically, all 11 house systems in structure.
info.x-guidance: Deterministic astrology calculations (no LLM). Every chart endpoint takes a JSON body with a local 'datetime' (e.g. '1990-05-15T14:30'), 'latitude' and 'longitude'; the historical time zone is resolved for you. Cheapest calls: POST /v1/western/positions ($0.01) and /v1/vedic/nakshatra ($0.02). Western natal chart: POST /v1/western/natal. Vedic birth chart: POST /v1/vedic/kundli. Marriage compatibility: POST /v1/vedic/gun-milan with person_a and person_b. Each response carries meta.result_sha256; POST /v1/verify recomputes it. Pay with x402 or MPP; first 3 calls free on the $0.01-0.02 routes. Free catalog: GET /v1/catalog.

post.description:
Local birth time + place -> exact UT, historical UTC offset, Delta T, Local Mean Time, true solar time.

The step LLMs most often get wrong. Resolves the IANA time zone from coordinates, applies the offset in force on that date (historical DST, Local Mean Time before standard time), flags ambiguous or non-existent local times instead of guessing, and returns Julian Days (UT/TT), Delta T, Local Mean Time, true (apparent) solar time and the equation of time.

datetime.description: Local birth date-time, ISO 8601: '1990-05-15T14:30' (local clock time at the place) or with an explicit offset '1990-05-15T14:30:00+02:00'. Alternative: 'date' + 'time'.

time.description: HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, 24 h. Omit if unknown (computed at 12:00 with a TIME_UNKNOWN warning).

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates, with the historical offset (DST, Local Mean Time) of that date.

time_basis.description: What the given clock time is: civil wall-clock (default), UTC, Local Mean Time, or true (apparent) solar time.

ambiguous_time.description: Which occurrence to use when a local time happens twice (DST fall-back).

schema.description: Coordinates or a timezone are needed to interpret a local time.

warnings.message: offset +05:30 for Asia/Kolkata comes from the IANA tz database, whose pre-1970 history is best-effort. If the birth record states the clock offset, pass it inside 'datetime' (e.g. ...T14:30+01:00).

meta.frame: geocentric apparent positions, true ecliptic and equinox of date (IAU 2006/2000A)
meta.reproducibility: result_sha256 = SHA-256 of the result serialized as JSON with sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8, floats rounded to 6 decimals. Same input + same engine version => same hash.

settings.varga_rules: Parashara (BPHS); D24 counts forward from Cancer in even signs

vashya.rule: group by Moon sign (Sagittarius and Capricorn split at 15 deg); groom row x bride column

tara.rule: count = ((to_nak - from_nak) % 27) + 1 (inclusive); remainder = count % 9, with 0 read as 9. Do this bride->groom and groom->bride. Each direction whose remainder is not in {3,5,7} scores 1.5; the total is 0, 1.5 or 3.

yoni.rule: 14x14 yoni matrix: same 4, friendly 3, neutral 2, inimical 1, sworn enemies 0

graha_maitri.rule: naisargika friendship of the Moon-sign lords: FF 5, FN 4, NN 3, FE 1, NE 0.5, EE 0

gana.rule: 3x3 gana matrix, groom row x bride column

nadi.rule: 8 if the nadis differ, else 0 (nadi dosha). Same nakshatra is still 0 in the score.

person_a.rule: Mars in house [1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 12] counted by sign from the lagna or the Moon (Venus reported for reference)
person_a.note: Matching two manglik charts is traditionally held to neutralise the dosha.

person_b.rule: Mars in house [1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 12] counted by sign from the lagna or the Moon (Venus reported for reference)
person_b.note: Matching two manglik charts is traditionally held to neutralise the dosha.
